sub 'imprimirAtendimento'

for each trnsremessaatendimento order remAreEnsCodigo, remAreEnsSequencial where prefCodigo = &prefCodigo where remCodigo = &remCodigo where remAreEnsCodigo = &AreEnsCodigo when &AreEnsCodigo<>0

sub 'imprimirAreaAtendimento' for each trnsAreaEnsino where prefCodigo = &prefCodigo where AreEnsCodigo = &remAreEnsCodigo

sub 'imprimirDados'
print printCabecalhoProdutos
